{{Top|leg}}
A '''watch''' was a type of [[Chronometer/Legends|chrono]] which an individual carried on his or her person.

[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] wore a watch, which he consulted during timed maneuvers aboard the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']].<ref name="HtE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] also used a watch, featuring a picture of [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on it. His arms were the minute and hour 'hands' while his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was the second hand.
{{Noncanonend}}
